purpose: Public-source research leads for versioned integration checks; not an executed benchmark
selection: Purposive discovery from primary public issue and fix records; not a representative sample

cases.observed_by_source: Compilation and legacy inspection passed; an explicitly modern client failed negotiation before the documented serving fix.
cases.candidate_check: Pin client protocol era and compare explicit legacy and modern clients.

cases.version_boundary: These are declared dependency ranges, not locked installed versions. The fix source separately reports wheel comparisons locating the enabled default guard at 3.4.3.
cases.source_reported_change: FastMCP dependency upgrade enabled Host/Origin guard defaults that differed from the earlier deployment behavior.
cases.observed_by_source: Loopback requests worked while external Host requests returned 421; default TestClient behavior could mask the failure.
cases.candidate_check: Explicit external Host and Origin headers, narrow-allowlist control, and independent entry-point subprocesses.

cases.observed_by_source: A user reports failure to initiate metadata discovery after non-Bearer authentication challenges.
cases.attribution_boundary: The proposed fix discusses preserving an earlier Bearer metadata URL across later challenges; it is not accepted proof of the full issue's root cause.
cases.candidate_check: HTTP stub with missing, non-Bearer, and ordered Bearer/non-Bearer challenges; inspect discovery requests.

cases.observed_by_source: A first tool call succeeded while later calls failed; later discussion and release notes concern assume-role credentials.
cases.attribution_boundary: Do not adopt the issue title's initial FastMCP cause as established, or generalize the released fix to all session errors.
cases.candidate_check: Multiple calls per session with controlled credential lifecycle, using a local stub before any authorized provider environment.
